policies.title: Dockerfile makes files world-writable
policies.description: Checks that no RUN chmod grants write to everyone.
policies.rationale: World-writable files in an image let any process in the container alter them.
policies.absence_note: No RUN instruction, nothing to flag.
policies.remediation: Use the narrowest mode (for example 755 for directories, 644 for files) and the right owner.

policies.title: Kubernetes volume default mode is world-writable
policies.description: Checks that Secret/ConfigMap volumes do not use mode 0777 or 0666 (YAML octal may be shown in decimal: 511 or 438).
policies.rationale: Secret contents readable by every user in the pod widen the blast radius of one compromised process.
policies.absence_note: No defaultMode set; the platform default applies.
policies.positive:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: a
    image: a:1
  volumes:
  - name: s
    secret:
      secretName: x
      defaultMode: 0777
policies.negative:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: a
    image: a:1
  volumes:
  - name: s
    secret:
      secretName: x
      defaultMode: 0400
